review.notes: TRIAGE mode: full structural scan (0 code fences, 0 suspicious headings, headings list clean) plus automated normalized 4-gram page-containment diff of all 26 PDF pages against the OCR markdown; all pages >=0.90 containment except figure pages (p2, p22-p25), whose missing spans are figure-internal text (Figures 2, 8, 10) and HTML-table cell reordering. Tables 1-6 digit streams compared against PDF p23-p24 text and matched, including Table 3's printed misspelling 'move banna' kept as printed and the 7-number action example '1 128 91 241 5 101 127' matching the print. The Table 4 footnote body was dropped while its superscript marker survives; restored after visual verification of a p24 render. Low-hit pages and table rows were line-checked; body prose on pages 3-21 was machine-scanned rather than read word by word. The p1 'Corresponding author(s): ...' colophon line was found dropped by the ghost-line scan and restored; the copyright colophon and arXiv stamp follow the corpus convention of being omitted.

Table 4 | Overall performance of two instantiations of RT-2 and baselines across seen training tasks as well as unseen evaluations measuring generalization to novel objects, novel backgrounds, and novel environments.
